title: Quantized transport of two-dimensional multifrequency solitons
summary: We consider Thouless pumping of two-dimensional quadratic solitons composed from coherently interacting fundamental frequency (FF) and second harmonic (SH) components propagating in a periodic $χ^{(2)}$ material. The pumping is induced by two mutually sliding two-dimensional lattices defined by shallow transverse and longitudinal periodic refractive index modulation.
